sql:
SELECT sat.dname
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sch.StatusType = 'Active' AND sat.rtype = 'S'
GROUP BY sat.dname
ORDER BY AVG(sat.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Alameda' AND NumTstTakr < 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' AND "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12'

SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name,
       s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip || ', ' || s.Phone AS full_communication_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT schools.Website
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
  AND satscores.cname = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT AVG(ss.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools sch ON ss.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.City = 'Fresno'
  AND sch.OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
  AND sch.OpenDate < '1981-01-01'

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT sc.School AS school_name,
           ss.cname AS county,
           ss.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.cname ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools sc
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE UPPER(sc.Virtual) IN ('YES', 'Y')
      AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY county, rn

SELECT satscores.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score, frpm.`County Name` AS county
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND satscores.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) / 12.0 AS monthly_average_schools_opened
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND f.`District Type` = 'Elementary School District'
  AND strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode)
   FROM frpm f
   JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
   WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Orange'
     AND f.`District Type` = 'Unified School District'
     AND s.StatusType = 'Merged') * 1.0
  /
  NULLIF(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode)
     FROM frpm f
     JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
     WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Orange'
       AND f.`District Type` = 'Elementary School District'
       AND s.StatusType = 'Merged'), 0
  ) AS ratio

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f."County Name" AS county,
        s.School AS school,
        s.ClosedDate AS closed_date
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.ClosedDate) <> ''
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM closed_schools
    GROUP BY county
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT county, cnt
    FROM county_counts
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM county_counts)
)
SELECT
    cs.county,
    cs.school,
    cs.closed_date
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_counties tc ON tc.county = cs.county
ORDER BY cs.county, cs.closed_date, cs.school

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN frpm."County Name" = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN frpm."County Name" = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.MailState = 'CA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND City = 'San Joaquin' AND ClosedDate IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'San Joaquin'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.Virtual = 'Partially Virtual'
  AND s.Website IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT 100.0 *
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
       NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter Funding Type" IS NOT NULL AND "Charter Funding Type" <> 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio_percentage
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" LIKE 'Santa Clara%'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Stanislaus'
  AND DATE(s.OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
  AND (s.FundingType = 'Directly Funded' OR f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded')

SELECT f."County Name"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
  AND (s.SOC = 'CEA' OR s.SOCType LIKE '%Youth Authority Facilities%')
GROUP BY f."County Name"
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Alpine'
  AND f.`School Type` LIKE '%District Community Day School%'
GROUP BY status

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
  AND f.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

SELECT `School Name`, `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'

SELECT f.`County Name` AS county, COUNT(*) AS amount
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY f.`County Name`
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AdmLName1, f.`District Name`, s.County, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CharterNum = '40'

SELECT DISTINCT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmEmail3
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND s.DOCType = 'Public'
  AND f.`District Name` = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND f.`School Type` IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools', 'Unified Schools')
  AND (
    (s.AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmEmail1) <> '')
    OR (s.AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmEmail2) <> '')
    OR (s.AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmEmail3) <> '')
  )

WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT f."School Name" AS name,
         s.DOCType AS doc_type,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS diff
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
)
SELECT name, doc_type
FROM locally_funded
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM locally_funded)

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND satscores.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollees
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special School'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Hickman'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND f.`District Type` = 'Elementary School District'

WITH admins AS (
    SELECT TRIM(`AdmFName1`) AS first_name, CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE `AdmFName1` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`AdmFName1`) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(`AdmFName2`), CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE `AdmFName2` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`AdmFName2`) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(`AdmFName3`), CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE `AdmFName3` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`AdmFName3`) <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS administrator_count
    FROM admins
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY administrator_count DESC, first_name
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    a.first_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.`District Name`) AS districts,
    nc.administrator_count
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admins a ON a.first_name = nc.first_name
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
GROUP BY a.first_name, nc.administrator_count
ORDER BY nc.administrator_count DESC, a.first_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Amador'
  AND f.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND s.GSserved = '9-12'

SELECT DISTINCT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT s.School AS name,
       s.Street AS street,
       s.City AS city,
       s.State AS state,
       s.Zip AS zip,
       s.Phone AS phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High School'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1) ELSE GSserved END) AS lowest_grade
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
  AND School = 'District Special Education Consortia School'

SELECT s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Merced'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
  AND f.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Latitude, f.`School Type` AS school_type
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f.attr_001 AS lowest_grade, s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE UPPER(s.State) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA')
  AND s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
SELECT Zip FROM schools WHERE District = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND Charter = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sch.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
JOIN frpm AS f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sch.City = 'Fresno'
  AND f.`District Type` = 'Directly Funded'
  AND sat.NumTstTakr <= 250

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.City = 'Fremont'
  AND frpm.`School Type` LIKE '%State Special School%'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND sch.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT `School Name`, `School Type`
FROM frpm
WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND substr(CDSCode, 1, 2) = '37'

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY t.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.ClosedDate LIKE '1989%'
  AND f.`District Type` = 'Community College District'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp AS di ON a.account_id = di.account_id JOIN card AS c ON di.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN trans AS t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.attr_001 = 'East Bohemia' AND c.issued > t.date

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.attr_001 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND dist.attr_001 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dist.attr_001 = 'Jesenik'

SELECT a.district_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, d.A4, d.A5
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.date > t.date

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE LOWER(d.attr_001) = 'east bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT l.account_id, d.A4 AS district, d.A5 AS region
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000

SELECT loan.loan_id, account.district_id, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A4 = 'Decin' OR d.A5 = 'Decin' OR d.A6 = 'Decin' OR d.A7 = 'Decin' OR d.attr_001 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT c.district_id
FROM client c
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY c.district_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.attr_001 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER'
  AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1996-02-01'
GROUP BY d.attr_001
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 'South Bohemia' IN (d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.attr_001)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id
  )

SELECT d.district_id
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.attr_001 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE d.attr_001 = 'Pisek'
  AND o.k_symbol = 'HOUSEHOLD'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.attr_001 = 'Tabor'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.attr_001 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT DISTINCT district.A4
FROM district
JOIN account ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.type = 'VYDAJ'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.attr_001 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
SELECT district.A4 FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.client_id = 3541

SELECT d.A4
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A4
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account AS T1 JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.A4 = 'Jesenik'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.date > '1996-12-31' AND ('Beroun' IN (d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.attr_001))

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.attr_001 = 'Prague'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920'
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(d.A4)) = 'east bohemia'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(d.A5)) = 'east bohemia'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(d.A6)) = 'east bohemia'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(d.A7)) = 'east bohemia'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(d.attr_001)) = 'east bohemia'
  )

SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id
FROM client c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'DISPONENT'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.attr_001 = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.attr_001 = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND d.A11 > 8000

WITH client_birth AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           c.district_id,
           (1900 + CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) * 10000
           + (CASE WHEN CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) > 50
                   THEN CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) - 50
                   ELSE CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 3, 2) AS INTEGER)
              END) * 100
           + CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_date
    FROM client c
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client_birth cb ON dp.client_id = cb.client_id
JOIN district d ON cb.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
  AND cb.birth_date = (
      SELECT MAX(cb2.birth_date)
      FROM client_birth cb2
      JOIN district d2 ON cb2.district_id = d2.district_id
      WHERE d2.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dist.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND CAST(substr(c.attr_001, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) > 50

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.attr_001 = '765129'
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.attr_001
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(c.attr_001) IN ('M','MALE') THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE LOWER(A3) = 'south bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
WHERE c."attr_001" = 'F'
GROUP BY c.district_id
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND LOWER(c.attr_001) IN ('m', 'male')
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM client
WHERE attr_001 = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.attr_001 = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(c.attr_001, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) > 50

WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
top_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM win_counts
    ORDER BY wins DESC, driverId ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
max_points AS (
    SELECT driverId, MAX(points) AS max_points
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, COALESCE(mp.max_points, 0) AS max_points
FROM top_driver td
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = td.driverId
LEFT JOIN max_points mp ON mp.driverId = td.driverId

WITH client_info AS (
  SELECT client_id,
         district_id,
         CASE
           WHEN json_valid(attr_001) THEN json_extract(attr_001, '$.gender')
           WHEN instr(attr_001, 'F') > 0 THEN 'F'
           ELSE NULL
         END AS gender,
         CASE
           WHEN json_valid(attr_001) THEN json_extract(attr_001, '$.birth_date')
           WHEN substr(attr_001, -10) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(attr_001, -10)
           WHEN substr(attr_001, 1, 10) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(attr_001, 1, 10)
           ELSE attr_001
         END AS birth_date
  FROM client
)

INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT driverId,
           (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> ''
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
                 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> ''
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL)
                 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> ''
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
                 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT T2.attr_001 AS full_name, T1.driverId
FROM (
    SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds

) AS T1
INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC
LIMIT 20

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS County,
        School,
        ClosedDate
    FROM schools
    WHERE attr_001 IS NOT NULL
      AND SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Closed'
      AND School IS NOT NULL
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT County

INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE T1.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND T3.year = 2008
  AND T3.circuitId IN (
      SELECT circuitId
      FROM circuits
      WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  )
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(T1.q3, 1, INSTR(T1.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
       + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.q3, INSTR(T1.q3, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.q3, '.') - INSTR(T1.q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL)
       + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.q3, INSTR(T1.q3, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT d.driverId,
           SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename,
           SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname,
           d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM driverStandings AS ds
        WHERE ds.driverId = d.driverId
    )
    ORDER BY JULIANDAY(d.dob) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_race AS (
    SELECT r.name
    FROM races AS r
    INNER JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    INNER JOIN youngest AS y ON y.driverId = ds.driverId
    ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC, r.raceId ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT y.forename, y.surname, y.nationality, fr.name
FROM youngest AS y
CROSS JOIN first_race AS fr

SELECT SUM(T1.wins) AS wins,

ORDER BY T2.dob ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT driverId,
           (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename,
       SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname,
       t.driverId
FROM (
    SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds
    GROUP BY driverId
) AS t
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON t.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY t.min_time_in_seconds ASC
LIMIT 20
